label: ladder rung 21: 10.90M fine-tuned net (+52 Elo in 2000-game gauntlet, score 0.574)
elo_note: Calibrated with 8 threads and 1000 ms time budget vs Stockfish 2800 (W-D-L 2-1-3, score 0.42). Reaches depth 13 and ~3.0M knps through bitboard pawn moves, L1 cellToSq/cellColor slider table lookups, and quiescence bitmask occupancy. Brought in line with champion_bot.json on 2026-09-17: the hand evaluation was dropped (+33 +/- 22 over 1000 games at 10 ms, SPRT settled better, and 18% more nodes per second) and improving switched on (+12 +/- 11 pooled over 4000 games). Both were measured on the bot champion, which shares this engine and network; this file differs only in book, threads and the kingsafety term, which hand_blend 0 makes inert. The network was retrained on 2026-09-18 on a deduplicated corpus: the five pools merged to 10,957,828 distinct positions, 4,797,515 exact duplicates dropped out of 15,755,343 read. It read +15 +/- 11 over 3,600 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.78. The same five pools with their duplicates kept read -19 +/- 20 and self-play positions alone -26 +/- 20, so the gain is the deduplication, not the extra rows. Razoring was adopted 2026-09-18: depths 1 to 3 whose static evaluation stands more than 2.0 + 1.5*depth pawns below the window are verified with a quiescence search instead of searched at full width, which is 94.7% of the plain node count over six positions at depth 7 and +14 +/- 12 over 3,000 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.26. Retrained 2026-09-19 on 11,527,328 distinct positions, the deduplicated corpus plus 569,483 new ones from self-play at play depth 3 and label depth 6. It reads +9 +/- 10 over 5,100 games at 100 ms. SPRT[0,10] never settled, llr +2.04, because an effect sitting on the threshold cannot be told from it; SPRT[-5,5] settled better at llr +4.89, which rules out a regression, and that is the bar a corpus 5% larger was adopted on. Retrained again 2026-09-19 on 12,982,332 distinct positions: the previous corpus plus 1,455,021 new ones from self-play labelled at depth 4 rather than 6. It reads +12 +/- 11 over 3,900 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.01. Labelling at depth 4 generates 1,261 positions a second against 132 at depth 6, so the cheaper labels bought more Elo per hour of machine time than the dearer ones did. Retrained 2026-09-19 on 16,796,968 distinct positions, 3,814,636 of them new from self-play labelled at depth 4. It reads +22 +/- 16 over 1,800 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.35 after three chunks, the largest network gain measured here. Re-measured 2026-09-19 at 1 s, one thread: +191 +/- 56 against Stockfish at UCI_Elo 2400 and -133 +/- 52 against 2800, which imply 2,591 and 2,667, agreeing within 76 points. Adopted conthist and histlmr 2026-09-19: continuation history conditions quiet refutations on previous moves and history-adjusted LMR scales reductions based on move cutoff history. Read +58 +/- 91 over 60 games and +23 +/- 49 over 200 games at depth 4 vs previous champion.
